description: Exposes the Nova IDE Integrated Browser (the same tab the user sees) to external agents via MCP and a CLI.
command.configureCliAgents: Nova Browser Bridge: Configure CLI Agents (Claude Code, Gemini, Codex)
command.copyToken: Nova Browser Bridge: Copy Bridge Token
config.title: Nova Browser Bridge
config.port: Preferred TCP port for the local Nova Browser Bridge server (MCP + REST). If it is busy, a free port is chosen automatically.
config.cdpPort: Preferred TCP port for the Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint (for chromium.connectOverCDP or @playwright/mcp --cdp-endpoint). If it is busy, a free port is chosen automatically. Connecting requires the bridge token and the same confirmation as nova.browserBridge.allowEvaluate.
config.allowedHosts: Hosts that `open`/`navigate` are allowed to reach by default. A URL whose host is not in this list is refused unless `#nova.browserBridge.allowExternalHosts#` is enabled.
config.allowExternalHosts: Allows agents to open/navigate to any host, not only those listed in nova.browserBridge.allowedHosts. Enable with care.
config.allowEvaluate: Allows agents to run arbitrary Playwright code (run_playwright / the CLI 'run' command) against Integrated Browser pages. The user is asked to confirm on the first attempt.
config.devServer.autoStart: Whether Nova IDE should automatically start the project's detected dev server when the folder is opened. 'ask' asks once and remembers the answer for this workspace.
